name: Hollister Farm
description: A big two-storey family farmhouse among corn and wheat: the dining room and kitchen (A), the living and family rooms (B), three staircases and a garden yard.

briefing.region: Corn country, Nebraska (fictional county), late summer
briefing.attack: Come in through the driveway gate or the garden gate and take the house: the porch, the patio, the side doors or the outside stair.
briefing.defend: Hold the house from upstairs; rotate through the foyer, the back hall and the upstairs hall.
briefing.A: The dining room and the kitchen on the east side: a long dining table, the island, the back stair from the mudroom.
briefing.B: The living room and the family room on the west side: the fireplace, the piano, the sofas and the french doors to the patio.

duel._comment: 1v1 duels: site A only (dining room and kitchen); a player-clip wall along x = -6.6 closes the west half (living, family, west yard).
